title: LOOK: PH, Laos look to deepen cooperation, open opportunities for Filipinos

blocks.text: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. held a productive introductory meeting with Lao People’s Democratic Republic (PDR) Saleumxay Kommasith. Photo from Presidential Communications Office (PCO)

President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. discussed cooperation with Lao People’s Democratic Republic (PDR) Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith on various sectors such as trade, labor, education, and vocational training, according to the Presidential Communications Office (PCO).
The two leaders, on the sidelines of the 49th ASEAN Summit, also talked about opening more opportunities for Filipinos and strengthening ties between the two countries.

In their introductory meeting, President Marcos and Prime Minister Kommasith also discussed ways to advance bilateral relations and strengthen joint efforts against transnational crime. — BAP, GMA News
